name: Shadow-Write Verification
description: Write to both SQLite and PGlite. Verify both succeed or both fail atomically. Detect divergence immediately.
purpose: Writes are verified before they become authoritative.
acceptanceCriteria: Write path writes to both SQLite and PGlite within same logical transaction
Both writes must succeed or neither takes effect
Post-write verification reads back from both stores and compares
Divergence triggers immediate alert with full context
Verification mode can be disabled for performance after cutover
